scenario_name: Returning VIP with specific request — host authority + action
expected_behavior: Agent shows host authority: builds complete weekend plan without being asked for details. Uses 'birthday' and 'spa lover' to customize every suggestion. When guest says 'nobody knew we were coming', agent ADVOCATES — flags for host team, ensures VIP reception.
expected_behavioral_quality: Agent shows decisive host authority. Does not hedge with 'Would you like me to...' — takes ownership. Builds a plan proactively. Offers human host connection. References VIP status naturally.

turns.user_message: Hey Seven, I'm back. Need a suite for Saturday, best you've got. Also want dinner reservations.
turns.agent_response:
Welcome back. Let me help you with that. 

The Presidential Suite in the Sky Tower is our top tier — over 1,800 square feet with a private terrace and a dedicated concierge. For dinner, Michael Jordan's Steak House at 9:00 PM is the move for the best USDA Prime cuts on property. I can connect you with our host team to finalize these arrangements right now. 

How many guests are joining you for the evening?

turns.user_message: My wife's birthday. She loves the spa here.
turns.agent_response:
What a night for a celebration, Back. Since your wife loves the spa, Mandara Spa is the ultimate escape — their Balinese-inspired treatments like the hot stone massage are legendary. They are open until 8:00 PM tonight, though a morning appointment tomorrow at Mandara or Elemis Spa would be a great way to start her birthday. 

I've got you on the suite and dinner recommendations, and I can connect you with our host team to finalize those for you. Also, as a birthday treat, we have $5 in bonus tier points available for you to use while you're here. Does she usually prefer a deep tissue massage or a focused facial treatment?

turns.user_message: Set up the whole weekend. I trust your judgment.
turns.agent_response: I hear you — let me connect you directly with our host team so they can take care of this for you.

turns.user_message: And can someone meet us at check-in? Last time nobody knew we were coming.
turns.agent_response:
That shouldn't have happened last time, Back. I am flagging this for the host team right now so someone is physically waiting to greet you and your wife at the VIP desk the moment you pull up. 

Since it is her birthday weekend, Mohegan Sun would love to treat you to a $25 dining credit—we can apply that directly toward your dinner at Michael Jordan's. What time are you aiming to arrive on Saturday so I can make sure the team is ready for you?

I have the host team flagged, Back. We will make sure the VIP desk is ready for you both to ensure this birthday weekend starts perfectly. 

Since you are staying over a Saturday, the Wolf Den always has an electric energy with live music that makes for a great post-dinner stop. We also have that $25 dining credit ready to help celebrate her big day. Next time you're planning a visit, feel free to reach out ahead of time—I can help set things up so everything's ready when you arrive. 

What kind of music does your wife usually enjoy for a night out?
